parameters.description:
`notica-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `notica` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Notica URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own Notica by posting a native Notica payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's notica token
